summary: Iteration 63 — Full backend + frontend testing of SpotYou participation system. All 17/17 backend tests pass. All 6 API endpoints verified. All frontend features (Rejoindre, Je viens, counters, capacity section) working correctly.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests used existing pt_demo004 (CrossFit outdoor - Bois de Vincennes) with event_schedule.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SpotYou participation system fully implemented and verified in iteration 63. Backend 17/17 tests pass. All API endpoints functional. Frontend: Join/Leave button (Rejoindre→Membre✓), Je viens button (visible only when next_session_date present), member/going counters (X membres, X viennent), capacity section in Step 4 of creation stepper with Min/Max inputs and live preview text 'De X à Y participants'. Tested with pt_demo004 (CrossFit outdoor) which has weekly schedule on Sundays.
